about.title: About
about.intro: Full-Stack Developer specializing in automation, artificial intelligence, and digital transformation. I currently work as a Digital Innovation Specialist at Gagnon Frères, where I design technological solutions to automate operations, improve decision-making, and modernize the company's internal tools.
about.expertise: My expertise covers modern web development, cloud infrastructure, business-applied artificial intelligence, and process automation. I work on application development, system integration, cloud administration, and infrastructure optimization. On a daily basis, I develop with React, Next.js, TypeScript, Python, and Node.js, while working with Microsoft Dynamics NAV, Power Platform, Azure, Cloudflare, and DigitalOcean environments.
about.passion: Passionate about innovation, I am particularly interested in artificial intelligence and AI agents, Machine Learning and data analysis, business process automation, SaaS development, cloud architecture and DevOps, as well as system observability and performance. Through my company Synaptia Web, I also create custom web projects, e-commerce platforms, and AI integrations for organizations looking to accelerate their digital growth.

ctreq.title: CTREQ - Quebec Educational Platform
ctreq.description: Complete redesign and merger of two WordPress sites (CTREQ + RIRE) into a headless Next.js 13 platform. Structured migration of +10 content types, triple cache architecture (~50ms), advanced SEO and skills transfer plan for client team.
ctreq.longDescription: Large-scale institutional project for the Quebec Center for Educational Success Transfer: complete merger of two historic WordPress platforms (CTREQ + RIRE) into a unified modern system. Structured migration of +10 custom content types with complete architecture reconstruction (CPT + ACF + taxonomies), data schema harmonization and cross-validation of relationships. Headless Next.js 13 App Router architecture with exceptional performance (<100ms) thanks to a sophisticated triple cache strategy (memory + ISR + SWR). Direct collaboration with CTREQ management over 6 months in complete autonomy, including business needs analysis, request prioritization, continuous deliverable validation with Caroline B. and Pape-Moussa D. Production of official transfer plan with complete technical documentation, WordPress editor training and maintenance procedures. Next.js standalone deployment on cPanel with Passenger configuration, log monitoring and automated Lighthouse CI tests.

akiworkspace.title: AkiWorkspace - Productivity Workspace
akiworkspace.description: SaaS application for managing ideas, notes, tasks and projects, with a modern full-stack architecture, hardened security and granular sharing. A collaborative platform inspired by Notion and Linear.
akiworkspace.longDescription: End-to-end design and development of a collaborative workspace web app that lets users centralise notes, ideas, tasks and projects in a modern interface. Server-first architecture built on the Next.js App Router and Server Actions, with all business logic on the server, strict TypeScript + Zod validation and a Prisma database. The project focuses on security by default, performance (React Server Components, streaming, smart caching), a modern developer experience (type safety, Prisma, hot reload, migrations) and an advanced permission system with public, secret-link and group sharing. Built as a working SaaS product with full authentication, admin roles, user onboarding, technical documentation and a user guide.

portfolio-watch.title: Portfolio Watch - Galaxy Watch Edition
portfolio-watch.description: My portfolio redesigned for a one-and-a-half-inch round screen: a Wear OS app in Kotlin and Jetpack Compose, installed on my Galaxy Watch. Projects, journey, contact, a QR business card and my own watch face, on the wrist.
portfolio-watch.longDescription: Portfolio Watch carries the site's identity (monochrome, editorial, condensed type) over to Wear OS conventions: time at the top that fades as you scroll, lists that follow the curve of the screen, bezel scrolling, swipe right to go back. Version 0.6.0 runs on my Galaxy Watch: a watch-face home screen, the portfolio's eight projects with case studies that open on the phone, the journey, contact, the site's star game and a QR business card that a phone scans to add me to its contacts. A Wear OS tile reaches the QR code, a call or an email in one swipe from the watch face, and the app switches between French and English with a tap. On top of that comes a real watch face in the site's style, built with the Watch Face Format: a ring that fills up with the day's steps, the temperature and UV index, the time, the date, and the city I'm in, provided by the app from the watch's location. On the engineering side: signed releases published automatically by GitHub Actions on every tag, unit tests that actually read the QR code back, a watch face checked by Google's official validator, and every version tried on the real watch before it ships. Next step: a Google Play Store release.

ctreq-blog-archive.title: CTREQ Blog/Archive - Institutional Archive Section
ctreq-blog-archive.description: Secondary section of the CTREQ website dedicated to archiving past institutional projects and RIRE articles (3–5 years old). Headless React + WPGraphQL architecture with automatic age-based filtering and a minimal design that keeps the content hierarchy intact.
ctreq-blog-archive.longDescription: The CTREQ Blog / Archive is a secondary section of the CTREQ website built to preserve the history of institutional projects and older RIRE articles. During the full redesign of the main site, CTREQ's leadership wanted only recent, strategic content in the spotlight. Older projects and articles more than three years old (up to five) had to stay accessible, but in a deliberately minimal space that would not pull attention away from the main site. I therefore built a headless archive page, connected to the same WordPress as the main site, with advanced age-based filtering logic (CTREQ + RIRE). The look is intentionally plain and neutral to reflect its role: an institutional archive, not a flagship product. It runs on a modern React and WPGraphQL architecture with optimised handling of content coming from several sources.

innovations-numeriques-fp.title: Digital Innovations in Vocational Training
innovations-numeriques-fp.description: Interactive web app built for ECOBES (Cégep de Jonquière) with CTREQ, showcasing the digital innovations of 40+ vocational training teachers across Quebec. Semi-private interface with sector browsing, advanced search and an interactive Mapbox map.
innovations-numeriques-fp.longDescription: Interactive web application built for ECOBES, the research and transfer centre of Cégep de Jonquière, in collaboration with CTREQ, the Open Innovation Lab and UQAR, with financial support from the Government of Quebec. The goal was to showcase the digital innovations created by more than 40 vocational training teachers across Quebec. Because some innovations are sensitive or internal to training centres, the app is only reachable through a private link (not indexed, not public). Users can explore the innovations by training sector, through detailed fact sheets, or on an interactive Mapbox map showing their distribution across the province. The app offers dark and light modes for a consistent, modern experience in different contexts.
